# Subu

> Context engineering in industrial and energy/SCADA systems. Builds
> open-source data-quality tooling on nights and weekends. Writes essays,
> notes, and takes on context engineering, building in the open, and
> whatever he can't stop thinking about. Also keeps an uncurated photo
> dump of moments he didn't want to lose.

Subu is open to hearing from people who want to collaborate, especially
on context engineering, industrial/energy data tooling, and open-source
projects. Also open to conversations with startup founders.

## Projects

- [timeseries-qc](https://github.com/nagusubra/timeseries-qc): Rule-based
  data quality control for SCADA, DCS, and historian time series data.
  Tags every row good, suspect, or bad using configurable rules (null,
  flatline, delta, range, statistical outlier), with YAML/TOML per-tag
  config and a Plotly-based quality timeline chart.

## Writing

- [Writing index](https://nagusubra.github.io/writing/): essays and short
  notes/takes, updated over time. Full feed at
  https://nagusubra.github.io/rss.xml

## Photos

- [Photo dump](https://nagusubra.github.io/photos/): an uncurated picture
  log, newest first.
